                        nc = total_cost(new_routes)

                            best_score = nc
        return best_routes

        nr = try_best_two_opt(routes)
        if nr is not None and total_cost(nr) <= total_cost(routes):
            routes = nr
            loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
            changed = True

        nr = try_best_relocate(routes, loads)
        if nr is not None and total_cost(nr) <= total_cost(routes):
            routes = nr
            loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
            changed = True
            continue
        nr = try_best_swap(routes, loads)
        if nr is not None and total_cost(nr) <= total_cost(routes):
            routes = nr
            loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
            changed = True
            continue
